sceneFacts.proactivePrompt: Ever wonder where Elle's vibrant sorority house was really filmed?
sceneFacts.factHeader: The Delta Nu Sorority House is a Historic California Landmark

factBeats.text: The exterior of the Delta Nu sorority house in Legally Blonde was filmed at the Villa del Sol d'Oro in Sierra Madre, California.
The Villa del Sol d'Oro's own website lists Legally Blonde among the films shot on its premises, confirming its use for the sorority house.
Production designer Missy Stewart described the intended aesthetic for the fictional sorority house as 'California mission style'.
Stewart explained the design choice was meant to emphasize 'sunny days and greenery' with a colorful palette, matching Elle's vibrant personality.

sceneFacts.proactivePrompt: Ever wonder where Elle Woods really went to Harvard?
sceneFacts.factHeader: Harvard's Campus Was Actually Southern California

factBeats.text: Despite being set at Harvard University, the majority of 'Legally Blonde' was filmed at various Southern California universities.
For scenes depicting Elle's arrival and class schedule pickup, Kerckhoff Hall at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) was used.
The California Institute of Technology (Caltech) in Pasadena also served as a stand-in for parts of Harvard's campus.
The Bovard Administration Building at the University of Southern California (USC) can also be spotted in the background of some campus scenes.

sceneFacts.proactivePrompt: Ever wonder where this courtroom scene was really filmed?
sceneFacts.factHeader: The Historic Courthouse Behind Elle's Trial

factBeats.text: The pivotal courtroom scenes in Legally Blonde were filmed on location at the Old Orange County Courthouse in Santa Ana, California.
This historic building, dedicated in 1901, is a popular choice for film productions.
Specifically, Courtroom No. 1, which is beautifully restored, is highly prized by filmmakers.

sceneFacts.proactivePrompt: Ever wonder about the meaning behind Elle's iconic pink courtroom outfit?
sceneFacts.factHeader: Elle's final pink outfit was a deliberate statement of self-acceptance.

factBeats.text: Costume designer Sophie de Rakoff confirmed that Elle's bright pink courtroom outfit was chosen to represent her embracing her authentic self.
The outfit was intended to be a statement of confidence and self-knowledge, refusing to let others diminish her.
The creative team decided pink would be Elle's signature color after visiting real-life sorority houses.

sceneFacts.proactivePrompt: Ever wonder where Elle's graduation was really filmed?
sceneFacts.factHeader: Elle's Harvard graduation was actually filmed in London.

factBeats.text: The graduation ceremony, where Elle Woods delivers her valedictory speech, was filmed at Dulwich College in London.
This unusual location was chosen because lead actress Reese Witherspoon was already in England filming another movie.
The entire graduation sequence was a last-minute addition, created after test audiences wanted a more conclusive ending for Elle.
Both Witherspoon and co-star Luke Wilson wore wigs for the scene, having changed their hairstyles for other film roles.
